title: [E16-04] Reproducible Setup, API and Firmware Documentation
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-04 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to document run/deploy instructions and demo limitations, so I can enable team use.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Documentation  
**Priority:** P0  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 3 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-046, US-047  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P0`, `release:B`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E16-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/30)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E16-11.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] README includes start, migrations, environment, firmware setup, API contracts, tests, deployment and demo limitations; never commit secrets.
- [ ] Document prerequisites, workspace commands, environment example, migrations and seed.
- [ ] Explain Next.js/NestJS boundaries, permissions, business states and error contracts.
- [ ] Include firmware board/wiring/build instructions or clearly labeled unavailable hardware.
- [ ] Document tests, deployment, reset, limitations and synthetic-data conventions without secrets.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Deliver repository README and linked setup/API/firmware guides; instructions must match commands actually available in the implemented project.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Follow documentation from clean checkout with placeholder environment and record successful startup/tests or explicit blockers.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
